_meta.purpose: A SHARED PUBLIC LAYER. Gene↔disease validity assertions from GenCC for the genes whose disease names match a system's filter — the monogenic half of a system panel, generated from a base with a version rather than written by hand. Nobody's genotypes are here.
_meta.source: GenCC — the Gene Curation Coalition, submissions export (TSV, new format)
_meta.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication; GenCC requests attribution to GenCC and the contributing sources whenever possible
_meta.citation: The Gene Curation Coalition. https://thegencc.org [date accessed: see `downloaded`]
_meta.kept: Every submitter's row and every classification, Limited/Disputed/Refuted included. GenCC does not re-check its submitters; a disagreement between two of them is shown, never averaged. Which classifications may be printed as a finding is decided by the engine, not here.
_meta.moi_code: Normalised mode of inheritance: AD, AR, XL, XLR, XLD, MT, SD or unknown. `moi` beside it is GenCC's own spelling; a mode outside this alphabet stays unknown here and keeps its spelling.
_meta.schema: systems: { <radar domain key>: { source, gene_count, genes: { SYMBOL: { hgnc_id, submissions: [ { disease, disease_id, classification, moi, moi_code, submitter, curated_on, gencc_version_or_date, mode, matched, submission_id?, submission_version? } ] } } } }
_meta.caveats: An aggregator's export, not a diagnosis: a gene here is a gene for which somebody has asserted a link to a disease of the system, with the strength they asserted. A substring filter over disease names misses a syndrome named after a person; add its MONDO id to the filter rather than widening a term.
_meta.source_tier_note: The rows are GenCC's submissions verbatim — disease, classification, inheritance, submitter and date as exported. Only `moi_code`, `mode`, `matched` and the grouping by system are this project's.
_meta.refresh_scope: Existing system gene identities and gene-disease concepts; every current submitter and classification within those concepts. No new genes or disease concepts.
_meta.refresh_policy: Preserve the accepted system membership and disease concepts; match by exact HGNC and MONDO identifiers, retain every current source assertion.

cardio.source: reports/179-panels-per-radar-segment-proposal-13.09.2026.md (13.09.2026): composed on the owner's decision of 13.09.2026, which added «Heart and vessels» to the radar, without waiting for a clinician's signature — the disease groups of the Genomics England PanelApp panels «Cardiomyopathies - including childhood onset», «Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy», «Brugada syndrome and cardiac sodium channel disease», «Long QT syndrome», «Catecholaminergic polymorphic VT», «Thoracic aortic aneurysm or dissection» and «Thrombophilia with a likely monogenic cause», plus the monogenic forms of the two outcomes whose polygenic scores stand on this system (coronary artery disease; the cerebral arteriopathy of ischaemic stroke) and monogenic hypertension, with every term checked title by title against the GenCC export dated 2026-09-06.
